# githubenterprise_team_organizations (Resource)

Authoritatively manages all organization assignments for a team in selected mode. Omitted organizations are removed. Use only one instance per team; import existing assignments first.

## Example

```hcl
resource "githubenterprise_team_organizations" "example" {
  enterprise_slug    = "my-enterprise"
  team_id            = githubenterprise_team.example.team_id
  organization_slugs = ["my-organization"]
}
```

## Schema

| Attribute | Type | Requirement | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enterprise_slug` | `String` | Required | Enterprise account slug. |
| `id` | `String` | Read-only | enterprise_slug/team_id. |
| `organization_slugs` | `Set[tftypes.String]` | Required | Complete set of lowercase organization slugs. An empty set removes all assignments. |
| `team_id` | `Number` | Required | Numeric team ID. |

## Import

```sh
terraform import githubenterprise_team_organizations.example my-enterprise/123456
```

See the [provider guide](https://github.com/vmvarela/terraform-provider-github-enterprise#authentication) for authentication, ownership and compatibility requirements.
